note: A 2027 guide has come with the 9M print two years running and would have to absorb the IRAP surcharge against a ~0.7bn plan (last year's first guide cost -9.3%); hydro proxy adds a little, buyback cushions a little, Q3 bar unsourced so all capped.

The H2 FY26 intake of ~GBP26m derived across three primary documents is unpublished and makes a cautious first FY27 statement the risk on a pre-released period; eMpulse, insider buying and a progressive dividend offset part of it.

H1 adjusted profit of 81.3m against a 115-140m FY guide leaves the guide confirmable at the upper end and the 30 Sep ratios should sit above SREP on the HTC gain plus RWA relief, with a 4.3% short covering into a stock down 37% in 60 days; MF's write-down reporting is the real offset and the window is the amc one (10 Nov close to 11 Nov close).
Low Q3 performance fees (Azimut negative, indices flat) against an expected inflow-target raise that monthly data already telegraph; single-broker bar, everything small and nearly offsetting.

The NII bar already sits at the top of the +15-18% guide so a confirmation reads soft, and a base-only interim dividend prints below last year's 0.60 headline, into a stock up 5% in five sessions above several targets; record inflows and possible performance-fee upside are mostly in the price.

H1 at 15%+ ROS implies ~$12-13m of operating profit against an ~$18m FY consensus that is two analysts and undated, so the outlook line is more likely firmed than cut on a thin stock that has given back the September upgrade; Hubbell's heavy-industrial softness is the proxy against it.

The first company quantification of Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 and a test of the ~SEK385m rights asset is a negative that a 32% drawdown has largely priced, against a mechanically large y/y revenue print on a weak comp that this name has sold before; genuinely two-sided, so 50 with offsetting findings and a large unsigned move.

A 27% sector-driven de-rating with estimates unmoved lowers the bar for an in-line print (prints after deep drawdowns rallied +13% and +11%) and the IFRS 2 charge flips to a gain, against FY consensus sitting at the top of the guide with no ad-hoc raise filed; the August insider sales are a sourced fact the hunter dropped as a duplicate, kept tiny.

Leverage at 2.7x against a 3.0x covenant with gearing above policy and a buyback throttled to token size from 14 Sep and stopped after 16 Oct is an under-read financing signal on a $150k/day name whose last three prints fell 9-12%; Herbalife EMEA still contracting adds, the Sofar-driven revenue headline is the one positive.

Recurring FCF tracks at the top of the 550-590m guide while the company-page consensus still sits at 576m, and reported take-private financing talks put a floor under a weak print; the Fastweb MSA restatement is the offset, on the amc window the hunter's timestamps establish.

9M was pre-released by the 21 Oct ad-hoc (+12.1%) and the guide was set three weeks ago with a CMD on 3 Dec, so only a conservative-looking revenue range leaves a small chance of a narrowing; the move will be mostly semicap beta.

9M adjusted near 1.0-1.1bn against a -0.5 to +1.5bn guide is derivable from VW's own release and the stock has tracked VW since, so only an explicit narrowing is unpriced; impairments have been looked through twice and the BGH ruling traded on 30 Sep.

Brazil MOP drifting below the mid-year level the guide midpoint assumes and TTF at 70-100 against a 45 assumption both point a narrowing toward the lower half of a range whose midpoint was set at consensus; Nutrien volumes, four straight Vara beats and a 4% short held flat argue the other way and keep it moderate.

Pandox's revenue-based leases on 48 Scandic hotels show Q3 occupancy ~2 points above Scandic's own flat-occupancy guide with ADR +4%, a real counterparty read of the quarter, but a +26% run to above targets and three straight print-day falls mean the bar has moved with it; Dalata pro forma growth looks soft.

Q3 is embedded in the 12 Oct upgrade and the stock is +17% since on that and a Danske note, so a release that only confirms meets a bar lifted twice in four weeks; a narrowing to the upper half, as at Q3 2025, is the modest offset.

The undisclosed Nscale 75 MW CSA value lands in Q3 intake against a NOK1.0bn comp and every observed print on this name has closed up or flat, against a +9.5% run-up mostly from the NRK award and Nscale counterparty noise; snippet-only bar so all small.

Svevia's Swedish-only Q3 PDF shows road O&M volumes and extra works rising, the Q3-25 base is depressed by Denmark and Norvia, and 440k shares went through in blocks the day before the print on a $200k/day name; the 3.9% margin guide needing a ~5% H2 is the two-sided risk, held at zero.

9M, the raised NI guide and the dividend policy were all ad-hoc'd on 4 and 6 Nov and have traded, the capacity-auction miss is in the domestic press, and strategy is reserved for the 16 Nov CMD; the only open line is how management explains the implied Q4 trough, whose sign is unknown.
